descriptions: Added customizable money format across the HUD — $, kr, €, or any custom template.
Added dirty money and gang pills that connect to your own gang or dirty-money scripts.
Added support for custom fuel scripts.
Added phone integration — the HUD now moves out of the way automatically when a phone opens. Supports lb-phone, RoadPhone, and gksphone.
Notifications now automatically avoid overlapping the player info stack.
Fixed the compass and progress bar snapping back to center after being dragged.
Fixed the minimap and speedometer not being draggable for some customers.
Fixed the 'Show Map on Foot' toggle doing the opposite of what it displayed.
Fixed the compass and Racing Angle speedometer ignoring your configured theme color.
Reverted an unintended change to the Edit Mode grid color.
Fixed overlapping text in the compass settings tab.
Fixed voice range (whisper/normal/shout) not working correctly with custom voice ranges.
Fixed global HUD settings not saving properly on some hosts.
The minimap curtain logo can now be changed — previously locked.
Fixed a recurring console spam error.
